# 1.618 Skincare

> 1.618 is a Korean skincare brand named after the golden ratio. Products are made in Korea and sold in the US on Amazon. This is the official English site. The official Korean store is https://1618cosmetic.com/.

## Products

- [1.618 Hyaluronic Acid Ampoule Toner](https://en.1618cosmetic.com/%ED%9E%88%EC%95%8C%ED%86%A0%EB%84%88%20%EC%83%81%EC%84%B8/toner.html): Toner, 200 ml / 6.7 fl oz. A hydrating toner with six forms of hyaluronic acid, panthenol, ceramide NP and collagen. Pat it on after cleansing, or soak cotton pads for a quick toner pack on dry areas. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08CGM1H45
- [1.618 Tea Tree Clearing Foam Cleanser](https://en.1618cosmetic.com/%ED%8B%B0%ED%8A%B8%EB%A6%AC%EC%83%81%EC%84%B8/teatree.html): Cleanser, 150 ml / 5.07 fl oz. A foam cleanser with tea tree leaf oil, centella asiatica and witch hazel water, built on an amino acid-based cleansing agent. Work it into a rich lather, massage gently and rinse. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09BTPXXLL
- [1.618 Volcanic Clay Blackhead Mask](https://en.1618cosmetic.com/%ED%99%94%EC%82%B0%EC%86%A1%EC%9D%B4_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8%EC%83%81%EC%84%B8/blackhead.html): Wash-Off Mask, 120 g / 4.23 oz. A wash-off clay mask with volcanic ash, kaolin and bentonite. Apply a thick layer, let it dry for about 10 minutes, then rinse to clear away excess sebum and impurities from pores. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09BQWRDJN
- [1.618 Salmon Firming Sleeping Mask](https://en.1618cosmetic.com/%EC%83%90%EB%AA%AC%EC%83%81%EC%84%B8/salmon.html): Sleeping Mask, 100 g / 3.53 oz. An overnight mask with salmon egg extract, peptides, niacinamide, adenosine and ceramide NP. Smooth it on as the last step before bed. No need to wash it off in the morning. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08CGNKFZ3
- [1.618 Intensive Wrinkle Care Cream](https://en.1618cosmetic.com/%EB%A7%81%ED%81%B4%EC%BC%80%EC%96%B4%EC%83%81%EC%84%B8_%EC%98%81%EB%AC%B8/wrinkle.html): Cream, 100 g / 3.52 oz. A rich face cream with adenosine, GABA, 17 amino acids and gold. Apply it to the whole face and to the areas where wrinkles concern you most. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B076Q26SF7
- [1.618 Artemisia Capillaris Essence](https://en.1618cosmetic.com/%EC%91%A5%EC%97%90%EC%84%BC%EC%8A%A4%EC%83%81%EC%84%B8/essence.html): Essence, 180 ml / 6.08 fl oz. A four-ingredient essence made with artemisia capillaris (mugwort) extract. Smooth it on after cleansing, or soak a cotton pad and leave it on for 5 to 10 minutes when skin needs quick soothing. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0DCNLN16W
- [1.618 Betula Calming Dual Mist](https://en.1618cosmetic.com/%EB%AF%B8%EC%8A%A4%ED%8A%B8%EC%83%81%EC%84%B8/mist.html): Mist, 90 ml / 3.04 fl oz. A two-layer face mist of birch sap and sunflower seed oil, with niacinamide, panthenol and centella asiatica. Shake to mix, then spray after cleansing or any time during the day. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CYWZLTF9
- [1.618 Hinoki Pore Tightening Ampoule](https://en.1618cosmetic.com/%ED%8E%B8%EB%B0%B1%EC%88%98%EB%AA%A8%EA%B3%B5%EC%95%B0%ED%94%8C%EC%83%81%EC%84%B8/hinoki.html): Ampoule, 30 ml / 1.01 fl oz. A pore care ampoule with hinoki water (98,000 ppm) and spicules, plus niacinamide, panthenol, six forms of hyaluronic acid and 17 amino acids. Spicules may cause a light tingling feeling. Buy on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GVDM7KKM
